concepts.title: Nest for a Dirichlet form
concepts.description: An increasing sequence of closed sets F_n such that the union of {u∈D(E):u=0 m-a.e. outside F_n} is dense in D(E) for the E₁ norm. A set is E-exceptional if it is contained in the complement of the union of some nest.

concepts.title: Process existence for quasi-regular symmetric Dirichlet forms
concepts.description: A quasi-regular symmetric Dirichlet form on a Lusin measurable state space is associated with an m-tight special standard process, unique up to the usual exceptional-set equivalence, whose L² semigroup is the semigroup of the form. The resulting process is m-symmetric; conservativeness requires an additional condition.

concepts.title: Quasi-continuity relative to a Dirichlet form
concepts.description: A real function has an E-quasi-continuous version if it agrees m-a.e. with a function whose restriction to every member of some E-nest is continuous.

concepts.title: Quasi-homeomorphism of Dirichlet spaces
concepts.description: A map between full nest unions of two Dirichlet spaces that restricts to a homeomorphism on each corresponding pair of closed nest sets, pushes one reference measure to the other, and identifies the two forms by pullback, including their domains.

concepts.title: Uniform exponential mixing of the ground-state-transformed Dirichlet diffusion
concepts.description: For a bounded connected Lipschitz domain and a smooth symmetric uniformly elliptic killed diffusion, let φ be its positive L²-normalized principal eigenfunction and γ=λ₂−λ₁. Its ground-state transition density K_t satisfies sup_{x,y}|K_t(x,y)/φ(y)²−1|≤C_εe^{−γt} for every t≥ε>0.

concepts.title: Spectral characterization of H₀¹ and the Dirichlet Laplacian domain
concepts.description: Let λ_n,φ_n be Dirichlet eigenpairs of−½Δ on a bounded C¹ domain. A function f∈L² is in H₀¹ exactly when∑λ_n|⟨f,φ_n⟩|²<∞, and then∫|∇f|²=2∑λ_n|⟨f,φ_n⟩|². For f∈H₀¹, its weak Laplacian lies in L² exactly when∑λ_n²|⟨f,φ_n⟩|²<∞. No global H² boundary regularity is asserted.

concepts.title: W²,ᵖ regularity of the Dirichlet Poisson problem
concepts.description: On a bounded C¹,¹ domain and2≤p<∞, for f∈Lᵖ the weak solution u∈H₀¹ of−Δu=f belongs to W²,ᵖ and satisfies‖u‖_{W²,ᵖ}≤C‖f‖_{Lᵖ}.

concepts.title: Principal Dirichlet eigenpair of a symmetric elliptic operator
concepts.description: For a connected bounded domain and a symmetric uniformly elliptic Dirichlet operator −L, the smallest eigenvalue λ₁ and its positive L²-normalized eigenfunction φ solve −Lφ=λ₁φ with zero boundary trace.

concepts.title: Discrete orthonormal Haar transform on a dyadic grid
concepts.description: For a vector of length2ᵐ, replace each consecutive pair by its normalized sum and difference, (a+b)/√2 and(a−b)/√2, then recursively transform the sums until a single average remains. Order the average and detail coefficients by scale.

concepts.title: Discrete sine transform of type I
concepts.description: The orthonormal real transform on ℝᴺ given by (Sy)_j=√(2/(N+1))∑_{k=1}ᴺy_k sin(πjk/(N+1)),1≤j≤N. Other discrete sine transform types are separate conventions.

concepts.title: Doob ground-state transform of a killed semigroup
concepts.description: If a positive function h satisfies P_tᴰh=e^{−λt}h, define Q_tf(x)=e^{λt}P_tᴰ(hf)(x)/h(x). This is a Markov semigroup representing the process conditioned by h; for a killed symmetric diffusion and principal eigenfunction h it describes conditioning to stay in the domain.

concepts.title: Doob’s L² maximal inequality
concepts.description: For a right-continuous square-integrable martingale M on[0,T], E sup_{s≤T}|M_s|²≤4E|M_T|².

concepts.title: Doob’s upcrossing inequality
concepts.description: If (X_n) is a submartingale and U_n(a,b) counts completed upcrossings from at most a to at least b by time n, then (b−a)EU_n(a,b)≤E(X_n−a)⁺−E(X₀−a)⁺ for a<b.

concepts.title: Doubly stochastic matrix
concepts.description: A square real matrix with nonnegative entries and every row and column summing to one. The uniform probability vector is stationary.

concepts.title: Duhamel formula for an inhomogeneous semigroup equation
concepts.description: If T_t is a strongly continuous semigroup with generator A and u is a classical solution of u′=Au+f with suitably integrable continuous forcing, then u(t)=T_tu(0)+∫₀ᵗT_{t−s}f(s)ds. The integral is a Bochner integral.

concepts.title: Dynkin’s π–λ theorem
concepts.description: If a family P contains the whole space and is closed under finite intersections, every family containing P and closed under complements and countable disjoint unions contains the σ-algebra generated by P.

concepts.title: Effective dimension in the truncation sense
concepts.description: For a nonconstant square-integrable function of n independent inputs and tolerance ε∈(0,1), the smallest k for which ANOVA components involving only the first k coordinates account for at least 1−ε of its variance.

concepts.title: Ehrenfest urn chain
concepts.description: A chain tracking the number of particles in one of two urns when particles switch urns, equivalently the number of ones in a collection of two-state coordinates. Discrete and continuous rates must be specified.
